name: manual_27354b
claim: Do not write agent fan-out logs to predictable absolute /tmp paths; create a secure unique log directory under the repo or approved user tool state, reject symlinked reusable parents, and keep stdout/stderr per task for audit.

decisions.notes: The Antigravity skill hardening replaced <local-out-temp> and <local-err-temp> with mktemp-created repo-local log directories and symlink checks to avoid local path-hijack attacks while preserving task evidence.

rationale: The Antigravity skill hardening replaced separate local output and error paths with mktemp-created repo-local log directories and symlink checks to avoid local path-hijack attacks while preserving task evidence.
